President Trump announces $100M Kentucky pharmaceutical investment as he rallies for Andy Barr
President Donald Trump announced plans for a $100 million federal investment in a Kentucky pharmaceutical manufacturing facility during his Saturday rally in Highland Heights, tying the project to Republican victories in November. "If the Republicans win, the Department of War will be investing $100 million in the pharmaceutical company and there to revitalize a gigantic drug manufacturing facility in Winchester, Kentucky," Trump told supporters. "That's a big revitalization project," he added, warning that the investment would not move forward under Democrat leadership. Trump, who traveled to Kentucky to campaign for Republican Senate candidate Andy Barr, also hailed his administration's efforts to bring pharmaceutical manufacturing back to American soil.
